contract: Exhaustive speed pass of the drop-a-folder-and-run path in PyMicroglia and Auto-Organotypic, to practical diminishing returns. Scientific outputs, labels, manifests and refusals must match the baseline exactly apart from declared volatile fields; a deliberate behaviour change is listed in the README with its reason.
material: A candidate is material when it can remove at least 10% or 0.5 s from a drop-step case, or at least 5% or 30 s per recording from a chain case.

budgets.drop to table: <= 1 s for 12 stacks, <= 3 s for 96 stacks or one instrument folder
budgets.run click to first stage shown: <= 2 s plus the page's polling interval

workloads.separate95: real Incucyte vessel 95 per-image export, 15,708 planes, read only
workloads.local1/12/96: hard links of one real 49-frame B4 Green+Red stack (1152 x 1536)
workloads.small: one real recording: B4, first day, 49 frames
workloads.typical: one real recording: B4, first three days, 145 frames
workloads.growth: three real recordings: B4 day 1, B5 day 1, B4 day 2
workloads.r20: 20 earlier run manifests beside one stack
